Applying that criterion requires seeing info-level findings, which bare mix spec.check hides — the adopter sees only 'info hidden; --verbose to show'. Add --verbose (or the SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1 form) to that line, matching the style specled_-xde used at the four probe sites.
